description.zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the simple application server.

description.zh:
快照列表的页码。

默认值：1。

分页查询时设置的每页行数。最大值：100。

默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 快照对应的轻量应用服务器所属的地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the simple application server that corresponds to the snapshots.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 快照ID。取值可以由多个快照ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个ID，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
description.en: The snapshot IDs. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 snapshot IDs. Separate multiple snapshot IDs with commas (,).

description.zh:
快照源云盘的云盘类型。取值范围：
- System：系统盘。
- Data：数据盘。
description.en:
The type of the source disk. Valid values:

- system: system disk.

- data: data disk.
Tag N that you want to add to the snapshot.

description.zh: 快照的标签键。标签键长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20。
description.en: The key of tag N that you want to add to the snapshot. A tag key can be 1 to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

description.zh: 快照的标签值。标签值长度的取值范围：1~64。N 的取值范围：1~20。
description.en: The value of tag N that you want to add to the snapshot. A tag value can be up to 64 characters in length. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

descriptions.zh: `InstanceId`、`DiskId`、`SnapshotIds`和`ResourceGroupId`不是必需的请求参数，但是可以构建过滤器逻辑，参数之间为逻辑与（And）关系。
descriptions.en: The `InstanceId`, `DiskId`, `SnapshotIds`, and `ResourceGroupId` parameters are optional. However, you can specify them as filter conditions and combine them with the logical AND operator to filter snapshots that you want to query.
